parole.testo: Uncertain. Not a Classical Arabic word. Possible etymologies: * From بَرُود (barūd, “a soothing collyrium (كُحْل (kuḥl)) used against inflammation of the eye; any powdery collyrium”), following common colloquial alteration between a and ā in words of the form CaCūC. * Via Aramaic from Armenian վառօդ
